label: Capital gain or (loss)
description: Form 1040 (2025), line 7a: capital gain or (loss) for the contracted direct-reporting class of Form 1099-DIV box-2a capital-gain distributions when Schedule D is not required (ADR-0050). Binds the selected closed box-2a family subtotal under Exception-1 eligibility. Does not implement Schedule D, Form 8949, or general capital-gains machinery.

published_value.explain: A current derived finding publishes this capital-gain distributions amount on the direct line-7a route.

computed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a computed zero from present box-2a findings that sum to zero under Exception-1 eligibility.

closure_backed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a zero because the box-2a family is attested closed on its current horizon with no recorded members, under Exception-1 eligibility.

blocked.explain: Line 7a is blocked because Exception-1 authority is incomplete or the box-2a family is unclosed.

guard_inapplicable.explain: No direct-route line 7a value exists because the checked Schedule-D-required conclusion is yes (any Exception-1 component is no).
